concepts.label: xdcrDiffer
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - a diagnostic/verification utility, included in the Server installation package, that acts as its own DCP consumer against BOTH the source and target clusters of an XDCR replication and reports missing or mismatched documents. First contact anywhere in the corpus, and the clearest confirmation in this batch of the brief's own prediction: this is genuinely new UI/tool-only vocabulary with no reference-page twin. Round 20's xdcr-reference/ tree documents filtering, settings, and security/networking - never verification or diffing - and Capella's own XDCR pages (round 7) have no equivalent tool at all, since Capella exposes no comparable node-level diagnostic-binary surface.

cross_component_finding: THIS IS THE BATCH'S CLEANEST ANSWER TO THE DISPATCH BRIEFING'S OWN NAMED QUESTION ABOUT xdcr-differ.md. It DOES introduce genuinely new UI-only (more precisely, tool-only) vocabulary: tool:xdcrdiffer has no reference-page twin anywhere in the corpus, unlike almost everything else in this batch, which reuses the xdcr:* family built from round 7 (Capella) and round 20 (server/8.0/xdcr-reference/).
